lobby.text: Gather under the moon. Your table is waiting.

reveal.text: Your secret awaits. Open your private card, then keep it close.

nightfall.text: Night falls. Everyone, close your eyes.

wolves.text: Werewolves, wake up and choose your victim.

seer.text: Werewolves, close your eyes. Seer, open your eyes and discover the truth.

witch.text: Seer, close your eyes. Witch, will you save a life or take one?

dawn.text: The sun rises. The village awakens.

voting.text: It's time to vote. Choose, then confirm your suspicion.

verdict.text: The village has spoken. Another night approaches.

discussion-classic.text: Everyone, open your eyes. Discuss what the night has left behind.

discussion-quick.text: The table is yours. Discuss where the wolf is hiding.

ended-village.text: The village wins. The truth came to light.

ended-wolves.text: The werewolves win. The night belongs to them.

ended-draw.text: A draw under the moon. This story awaits another night.

lobby.text: 月下集结，你的牌桌已就绪。

reveal.text: 秘密身份等待揭晓。查看你的身份牌，然后守好秘密。

wolves.text: 狼人请睁眼，选择你们的袭击目标。

seer.text: 狼人请闭眼。预言家请睁眼，查验隐藏的真相。

witch.text: 预言家请闭眼。女巫请睁眼，今晚你会救人，还是毒人？

voting.text: 投票时间到了。作出选择，然后确认你的指认。

verdict.text: 村庄已作出选择，新一轮黑夜即将降临。

discussion-classic.text: 所有人请睁眼，讨论昨夜留下的线索。

discussion-quick.text: 开始讨论，找出狼人藏在哪里。

ended-village.text: 村庄获胜，真相终于浮现。

ended-wolves.text: 狼人获胜，今夜属于群狼。

ended-draw.text: 月下平局，这个故事等待下一夜继续。
